Thanks Camila — I reviewed the ask. A few items we need clarified before we can post anything: 

1) Treatment: Is this a promotional allowance (contra revenue) or a waiver/adjustment on an existing invoice (invoice offset)? Classification affects GLA and revenue recognition.
2) PO / Contract reference: AP requested a PO number to attach to any credit memo. If Cognito will provide a PO, please include.
3) Suggested GL account and cost center: If we treat as promotional allowance, we usually post to 7012-Promo-Allowance and sweep monthly. If invoice offset, we need the invoice number to apply the credit.

I've attached a quick worksheet with suggested token->USD mapping and the JE template for Accounting to use.

attachments: trial_credit_worksheet.csv

If we decide credit memo route, route DocuSign with the "Credit Memo Acknowledgement" template and include the PO. If invoice-offset, send invoice ref and I'll coordinate AR application. Looping in Neha for JE posting and audit/controls sign-off.

—Marcus

Thanks Marcus — accounting view below.

- We prefer issuing a formal credit memo tied to the PO (if provided). For Cognito's case a credit memo preserves audit trail and matches our promo allowance policy.
- GL: use 7012-Promo-Allowance (debit) / 1200-AR (credit offset) when posting. Please note we sweep promo allowance monthly; include cost_center=ENG-PROMO in the JE.
- Documentation: include the PO, the signed credit memo (DocuSign), and the trial_credit_worksheet.csv in the supporting folder.

I've attached JE_template.xlsx and a short checklist for documentation. Once DocuSign is returned, Accounting will post the JE within the next billing cycle and AR will apply the credit to the customer's account.
